reference.title: Model card rendering configuration fields
reference.shortdesc: The following configuration fields enable Red Hat Quay to display Model Card metadata in the UI for OCI-compliant machine learning images. Model Cards are a form of metadata documentation commonly used in machine learning workflows to improve the visibility and management of model-related content within OCI-compliant images.

entry.p: Enables Model Card image tab in UI. Defaults to True.
Defines the model card artifact type.
This optional field defines the layer annotation of the model card stored in an OCI image.
This optional field defines the layer annotation of the model card stored in an OCI image.

section.codeblock: FEATURE_UI_MODELCARD: true UI_MODELCARD_ARTIFACT_TYPE: application/x-mlmodel UI_MODELCARD_ANNOTATION: org.opencontainers.image.description: "Model card metadata" UI_MODELCARD_LAYER_ANNOTATION: org.opencontainers.image.title: README.md

dlentry.dd: Specifies enabling the Model Card image tab in the UI.
Specifies the model card artifact type. In this example, the artifact type is application/x-mlmodel.

Specifies manifest-level annotation lookup when an image does not have an artifactType defined. If a matching annotation is found, the system then searches for a layer with an annotation matching UI_MODELCARD_LAYER_ANNOTATION. This field is optional.
Specifies the layer annotation used to locate the specific layer containing the model card when an image has an artifactType defined and multiple layers. This field is optional.
